create_interceptor: create a DefaultValueClientInterceptor that returns a default value when a gRPC unary call fails
intercept_unary_unary: intercept unary-unary gRPC calls and return a fallback value on exception
intercept_stream_unary: intercept stream-unary gRPC calls and return a fallback value on exception
review_ConcreteValue: review the _ConcreteValue class that implements grpc.Future to wrap a static result
build_interceptor_with_default: build a gRPC client interceptor that substitutes a default response when the server call raises an exception
